clauses.heading: Parties
clauses.body: This Lease is made between Harbor Properties LLC and Cedar Health Ltd.

clauses.heading: Term
clauses.body: The term is set out in clause 2.1 to clause 2.3 below.

clauses.heading: Duration
clauses.body: The term is one (1) year from the commencement date.

clauses.heading: Renewal
clauses.body: This Lease does not renew automatically.

clauses.heading: Payment
clauses.body: Charges are payable monthly in advance on the first day of each month.

clauses.heading: Price Changes
clauses.body: Charges increase by 3.5 percent on each anniversary of the commencement date.

clauses.heading: Limitation of Liability
clauses.body: The liability of either party is capped at two times the annual fees.

clauses.heading: Termination
clauses.body: Either party may terminate for material breach on thirty (30) days written notice.

clauses.heading: Confidentiality
clauses.body: Each party keeps the other party's information confidential.

clauses.heading: Notice of Non-Renewal
clauses.body: Either party may end this Lease at expiry by giving sixty (60) days written notice before the end of the term.

clauses.heading: Governing Law
clauses.body: This Lease is governed by the laws of the State of California.
